summary: A one-year, 35-lesson Bible study built on Part I of John Bunyan's The Pilgrim's Progress. Each lesson pairs a reading from a modernized, Scripture-referenced version of the allegory with teaching on the doctrine or life issue that episode pictures: conviction and conversion, assurance, the local church, spiritual warfare, worldliness, false profession, backsliding, perseverance, death and heaven.

toc.label: Unit 1
toc.covers: Background to Bunyan and his book, then the pilgrim's conviction of sin and his first steps toward salvation.

children.label: Chapter 1
children.title: The Pilgrim's Progress: an Overview
children.covers: The book's history and style and its main truths: the sinner's need of rescue, salvation through the cross, Scripture as the believer's weapon, and the hard road of discipleship.

children.label: Chapter 2
children.title: John Bunyan and the Pilgrim's Progress
children.covers: Bunyan's life, conversion, preaching, imprisonment and spiritual struggles, presented as an example of God pursuing sinners.

children.label: Chapter 3
children.title: The Soul under Conviction
children.covers: Graceless (the pilgrim before conversion) burdened by sin, his family's reaction, and Evangelist pointing him to the way; how hearing the gospel brings conviction or hardening.

children.label: Chapter 4
children.title: Obstinate, Pliable, and the Slough of Despond
children.covers: Two neighbors who refuse salvation or lack perseverance, and the slough as the fears and doubts of a seeker.

children.label: Chapter 5
children.title: Mr. Worldly Wiseman: Law and Grace
children.covers: The detour toward Legality and Mount Sinai; contrasts salvation by law-keeping with salvation by grace through Christ alone.

toc.label: Unit 2
toc.covers: Entering the Way, conversion at the cross, and the believer's need of the church.

children.label: Chapter 6
children.title: The Wicket-Gate and the Interpreter
children.covers: Pilgrim enters through the gate opened by Goodwill; Christ as the only door, and choosing the right guides.

children.label: Chapter 7
children.title: The Interpreter's House
children.covers: Lessons at the Interpreter's house, read as the ministry of the Holy Spirit and the gospel minister; hunger for Scripture as an evidence of new life.

children.label: Chapter 8
children.title: The Cross and the Robe
children.covers: The burden falls away at the cross: forgiveness, assurance, and the robe of Christ's righteousness; Formalist and Hypocrisy show that how one seeks salvation matters.

children.label: Chapter 9
children.title: The Palace Beautiful
children.covers: The Hill of Difficulty, the chained lions, the Porter and four ladies; the local church's fellowship, teaching and watchful leadership.

children.label: Chapter 10
children.title: The Blessings of the Palace Beautiful
children.covers: The church as body, building and bride of Christ, and the fellowship, doctrine and encouragement believers receive there.

toc.label: Unit 3
toc.covers: Spiritual warfare and the marks of genuine versus merely verbal faith.

children.label: Chapter 11
children.title: The Battle with Apollyon
children.covers: Christian fights Apollyon in the Valley of Humiliation; Satan as accuser defeated at the cross, and the shape of humility.

children.label: Chapter 12
children.title: The Valley of the Shadow of Death
children.covers: The valley as attacks of doubt and depression, drawn from Bunyan's own experience; deliverance through prayer, grace and fellow believers.

children.label: Chapter 13
children.title: Christian Meets Faithful
children.covers: Faithful's encounter with Wanton; sexual purity and steadfast faith.

children.label: Chapter 14
children.title: Faithful's Further Adventures
children.covers: Adam the First and his offspring (lust of the flesh, lust of the eyes, pride of life) and Shame; starving the old nature and feeding the new.

children.label: Chapter 15
children.title: Faithful Meets Talkative
children.covers: A man fluent about religion but unchanged; faith judged by walk, not talk.

children.label: Chapter 16
children.title: Talkative Meets His Match
children.covers: Testing a profession of faith; evidences of new birth such as conviction, repentance and faith, open confession of Christ, and a holy life.

toc.label: Unit 4
toc.covers: Vanity Fair: the Christian's relationship to the world and persecution.

children.label: Chapter 17
children.title: Evangelist
children.covers: Evangelist's warning before Vanity Fair; pastoral care for people over programs, and living with eternity in view.

children.label: Chapter 18
children.title: The World--Vanity Fair
children.covers: The fair as the world system; a working definition of worldliness as whatever displaces service to God.

children.label: Chapter 19
children.title: The Christian in the World
children.covers: The pilgrims' difference provokes mockery and abuse; believers as in but not of the world and sent into it with the gospel.

children.label: Chapter 20
children.title: Faithful's Trial and Death
children.covers: Trial before Lord Hate-good and Faithful's martyrdom; opposition from the world and final victory in Christ.

toc.label: Unit 5
toc.covers: Divided loyalties, love of money, and the danger of shortcuts.

children.label: Chapter 21
children.title: Christian, Hopeful, and By-Ends
children.covers: Hopeful joins Christian; By-ends tries to serve God and the world at once (no one can serve two masters).

children.label: Chapter 22
children.title: By-Ends and His Companions
children.covers: Hold-the-world, Save-all and Money-love defend religion for gain; examining one's motives for serving God.

children.label: Chapter 23
children.title: Demas--Love of the World
children.covers: Demas and the silver mine at the hill Lucre; resisting temptation by preparing the heart, and the danger of spiritual apathy.

children.label: Chapter 24
children.title: The Shortcut
children.covers: By-path Meadow, capture by Giant Despair, and escape with the key called Promise; no shortcuts to godliness, backsliding and repentance, walking by faith.

children.label: Chapter 25
children.title: The Delectable Mountains
children.covers: The Shepherds show four scenes (Error, Caution, the door, Clear); pastors who feed the flock on Scripture, and trials that drive believers to the Word.

toc.label: Unit 6
toc.covers: False assurance, weak faith, and spiritual dangers late in the journey.

children.label: Chapter 26
children.title: Ignorance and Turn-Away
children.covers: Ignorance trusts his good deeds; Turn-away is carried off; the link between impurity and apostasy.

children.label: Chapter 27
children.title: Little-Faith
children.covers: Little-faith robbed by Faint-heart, Mistrust and Guilt; weak faith loses joy but not the believer's inheritance.

children.label: Chapter 28
children.title: Little-Faith's Wealth
children.covers: Dwelling on past failure versus claiming by faith the riches promised in God's Word.

children.label: Chapter 29
children.title: The Fowler (Flatterer) and the Atheist
children.covers: Caught in Flatterer's net and freed by an angel, then meeting Atheist; Scripture as the guide through trials and temptation.

children.label: Chapter 30
children.title: The Enchanted Ground
children.covers: Spiritual drowsiness when life is easy; fellowship around the Word keeps believers alert; Hopeful tells his conversion.

children.label: Chapter 31
children.title: Ignorance
children.covers: Ignorance claims salvation without entering by the gate; salvation cannot rest partly on Christ and partly on good works.

toc.label: Unit 7
toc.covers: Godly fear, the believer's last days, death, heaven, and the end of the self-deceived.

children.label: Chapter 32
children.title: Fear
children.covers: Godly fear that drives a sinner to Christ versus selfish fear; the steps by which a temporary professor falls away.

children.label: Chapter 33
children.title: Beulah
children.covers: The land of Beulah as the believer's final days; living for Christ's honor rather than pleasure or riches.

children.label: Chapter 34
children.title: The Celestial City
children.covers: Crossing the River of Death and welcome into the city; the Christian view of death and heaven.

children.label: Chapter 35
children.title: The Awful End of a Sinner
children.covers: Ignorance is ferried over by Vain-hope but turned away at the gate; a warning that one can be self-deceived about salvation.

notes: Units are numbered only (no unit titles) in both manuals; the 'covers' line for each unit is a summary of its chapters. The study treats Part I of The Pilgrim's Progress only (not Christiana's story). Starting with Chapter 3 each lesson has a student reading from Positive Action's own modernized text of Bunyan. The publisher recommends grades 9-11. Edition labels disagree between the two samples (Student Manual says 4th ed. 2009; Teacher's Manual says 3rd ed. 2010), but the school's ISBN 978-1-59557-105-2 is the current Student Manual. The Student Manual's chapter titles are used; the Teacher's Manual capitalizes a few differently (e.g. 'An Overview').
